records.claim_text: QQE treats quality appraisal as informed purpose-fit judgement rather than mechanistic rule-following, and notes that not every indicator is relevant to every study.
records.limitations: Guidance does not validate the proposed payroll framework or require a full evidence pack, score, experimental causal design or equal detail for every case.
records.population: Official qualitative quality guidance or explicit researcher application, not observed payroll participants
records.time_period: Guidance rechecked29October2026; no empirical time series
records.review_mode: Relevant original HTML sections inspected and retained with separate parsed text

records.claim_text: QQE asks whose evaluative judgement is reported and on what basis, the source of divergent appraisals, document origins/status and the traceable route from evidence to interpretation.
records.limitations: Not a finding that any actual JGA contributor is inaccurate or in conflict. Agreement, acceptance, multiple links and a source label do not independently verify a particular claim.
records.population: Official qualitative quality guidance or explicit researcher application, not observed payroll participants

records.claim_text: R08 should selectively attach a material claim to its source, scope/date and knowledge basis, noting whether it is corroborated, qualified or unresolved without collapsing evidence acceptance into credibility or causal influence.
records.limitations: No ordinal confidence score, required document/extra interview question or assumption that direct testimony is inherently superior for every claim. Absence of corroboration is not automatically false; independent basis must be demonstrated when claimed.
records.population: Official qualitative quality guidance or explicit researcher application, not observed payroll participants

records.claim_text: Where material accounts differ, preserve each scoped account, inspect whether the differences concern object, timing or criteria, and retain a remaining disagreement or alternative explanation rather than average it into consensus.
records.limitations: No invented dispute, source adjudication, majority-vote truth, saturation claim or automatic duty to recontact. Existing permission, burden and knowledge limits remain; actual case evidence is still required.
